snippet.title: Animated Short Film | Roamer's Strettos (EN Dubbed Ver.)
snippet.description:
Time's curtain rises slow, its veil drawn to the whispers of note.
Strings fray, where scattered thoughts fade.
Hidden in this misty scene, recite in murmurs of remembrance keen.
Dreams decay, from her, yet the iris blooms on, forever.
————————————————————
"I don't know how to compare my affection in verse or rhyme, for this fevered pulse defies all logic."
#punishinggrayraven #PGR
